header.name: Galaxy Sun V06
header.description: Galaxy Sun, increment 6: the drift sped up so each planet's trail reads as a helix (one year moves the Sun four orbit diameters). Same scale as V05 (1 AU = 120 in). Not the true speed: at true speed the trail is a row of loops (V05).
